name: eduplus-ai
description: EduPlus AI — early academic-risk identification and intervention tracking (CBC 2.0 · PS-055)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @eduplus/core && npm run build --workspace @eduplus/mcp && npm run build --workspace @eduplus/voice
scripts.test:rules: node firebase/kill-emulators.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @eduplus/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @eduplus/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @eduplus/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace @eduplus/voice
scripts.seed:emulator: node firebase/kill-emulators.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --env-file=.env.emulator firebase/seed.ts"
scripts.demo:reset:emulator: node firebase/kill-emulators.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --env-file=.env.emulator firebase/demo-reset.ts --yes"
scripts.test:integration: node firebase/kill-emulators.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
